typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

struct Matrix {
    int mat[33][33];
} identity, base[70], result, prefix[70], suffix[70];

ll n, k;

void printMatrix(Matrix m) {
    for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; ++j)
            cout << m.mat[i][j] << ' ';
        cout << '\n';
    }
    cout << '\n';
}

Matrix multiply(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
    Matrix c = identity;
    for (int k_idx = 0; k_idx <= k; ++k_idx) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; ++j) {
                ll temp = (static_cast<ll>(a.mat[i][k_idx]) * b.mat[k_idx][j]) % MOD;
                c.mat[i][j] = (c.mat[i][j] + temp) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    return c;
}

void preprocess() {
    prefix[0] = base[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < k; ++i)
        prefix[i] = multiply(prefix[i-1], base[i]);
    
    suffix[k-1] = base[k-1];
    for (int i = k-2; i >= 0; --i)
        suffix[i] = multiply(base[i], suffix[i+1]);
    
    base[0] = suffix[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < k; ++i)
        base[i] = multiply(suffix[i], prefix[i-1]);
}

void solve() {
    cin >> n >> k;
    int i, j;
    result = identity;
    for (i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        base[i] = identity;
        for (j = 0; j <= k; ++j)
            base[i].mat[j][j] = 1;
        for (j = 0; j <= k; ++j)
            base[i].mat[j][i] = 1;
        result.mat[i][i] = 1;
    }
    result.mat[k][k] = 1;
    
    for (; n > 0; n /= k) {
        int digit = n % k;
        if (digit) {
            ll pos = 0, temp = n;
            while (temp) {
                pos = (pos + (temp /= k)) % k;
            }
            for (i = digit - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                result = multiply(base[(pos + i) % k], result);
            }
        }
        preprocess();
    }
    
    int answer = 1;
    for (i = 0; i < k; ++i)
        answer = (answer + result.mat[k][i]) % MOD;
    cout << answer << '\n';
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const ll MOD = 1000000007;

struct Matrix {
    vector<vector<int>> m;
    int n;
    Matrix(int size) : n(size) {
        m.resize(size, vector<int>(size, 0));
    }
    void setIdentity() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) m[i][i] = 1;
    }
    void setDiagonalOnePlusCol(int col) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            m[i][i] = 1;
            m[i][col] = (m[i][col] + 1) % MOD;
        }
    }
};

Matrix multiply(const Matrix& A, const Matrix& B) {
    Matrix C(A.n);
    for (int k = 0; k < A.n; ++k)
        for (int i = 0; i < A.n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < A.n; ++j) {
                ll val = (ll)A.m[i][k] * B.m[k][j] % MOD;
                C.m[i][j] = (C.m[i][j] + val) % MOD;
            }
    return C;
}

void preprocess(vector<Matrix>& bases, vector<Matrix>& prefix, vector<Matrix>& suffix) {
    int K = bases.size();
    prefix[0] = bases[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i)
        prefix[i] = multiply(prefix[i-1], bases[i]);
    
    suffix[K-1] = bases[K-1];
    for (int i = K-2; i >= 0; --i)
        suffix[i] = multiply(bases[i], suffix[i+1]);
    
    bases[0] = suffix[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i)
        bases[i] = multiply(suffix[i], prefix[i-1]);
}

void solve() {
    ll N;
    int K;
    cin >> N >> K;
    
    Matrix Iden(K+1);
    Iden.setIdentity();
    
    vector<Matrix> bases(K, K+1);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        bases[i] = Iden;
        bases[i].setDiagonalOnePlusCol(i);
    }
    
    Matrix res(K+1);
    res.setIdentity();
    
    for (ll x = N; x > 0; x /= K) {
        int digit = x % K;
        if (digit) {
            ll pos = 0;
            ll tmp = x;
            while (tmp) {
                pos = (pos + (tmp /= K)) % K;
            }
            for (int i = digit - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                res = multiply(bases[(pos + i) % K], res);
            }
        }
        vector<Matrix> prefix(K, K+1), suffix(K, K+1);
        preprocess(bases, prefix, suffix);
    }
    
    int ans = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i)
        ans = (ans + res.m[K][i]) % MOD;
    cout << ans << '\n';
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
